dedupe_keys.name: inspire geoportal lt flood hazard datasets

description: inspire-geoportal.lt: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal of Lithuania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire-geoportal.lt. Coverage: the area served by inspire-geoportal.lt. The listing groups 19 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (as-is). Potvynių grėsmės žemėlapiai. P; prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (kaip yra) – potvynių rizikos žemėlapia; prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (atitinkantis reikalavimus). INSPIRE AT; prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (atitinkantis reikalavimus). Preliminar. Formats seen: SHP, WMS, GML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lt.
